title: 鲁比尼英伟达变局：反成美国AI助力，对华芯片管制会更严吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Nooran Rabini of Rabini Macro Associates writing the bullish case for AI is even more bullish.
segments.zh: 鲁比尼宏观协会的诺里尔·鲁比尼认为，AI的看涨理由更加看涨。

segments.en: Nooran joins us now for more. Nooran, good morning. Good morning. Good for second time. Good to see you, buddy.
segments.zh: 诺里尔现在加入我们。诺里尔，早上好。早上好。第二次了。很高兴见到你，伙计。

segments.en: Nice to meet you. Just expand that. Just if you can. Where do you think this is going?
segments.zh: 很高兴见到你。请展开说说。如果可能的话。你认为这会走向何方？

segments.en: Well, in my view, we are in a race where China is going to dominate AI and it's all about frontier chips and frontier models. Why do I say this is a boon for the U.S.
segments.zh: 在我看来，我们正处于一场竞赛中，中国将在AI领域占据主导，关键在于前沿芯片和前沿模型。为什么我说这对美国是利好？

segments.en: for three reasons. Reason number one, after what happened, as we agree, exor controls on chips are going to become much more radical.
segments.zh: 有三个原因。第一，在发生的事情之后，正如我们一致认为的，芯片出口管制将变得更加激进。

segments.en: And all this thing of bypassing the Singapore or whatever not to get the advanced chip to China is going to stop completely. And they need those advanced chips to improve
segments.zh: 所有通过新加坡等地绕过限制向中国获取先进芯片的做法将完全停止。而他们需要这些先进芯片来改进
